content:
Maria P: Quick sync — narrow-scope handoff for SDK & SampleKit. Cutoff for changelog/quickstarts is in ~48h. Who's owning final sampleapp smoke + changelog slice? Need code review pings too.
Ken L: @maria I can own sampleapp smoke and CI checks. Will run final matrix tonight. Any specific flaky tests to flag?
Maria P: Thanks @ken. Flaky: `sample-integration.test::auth-flow` and the macOS builder (`ci:build:macos`) tends to time out. If you hit them, ping @ryan for retries.
Ken L: noted. I'll start with a local reproduce then queue the matrix. Command I use: ```./scripts/smoke_run.sh samplekit --region=dedicated``` — will paste results.
Ryan G: on it. Also I'll take the changelog slice if nobody else volunteers. I'll draft bullet points today and tag for review. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/312
Sarah H: I can finish the quickstart README updates (small wording + code snippet). Will inline the code snippet for the new `client.create_session()` example.
Alex T: @sarah can you also drop a note in the release checklist for the samplekit version bump? I didn't see a PR for that yet.
Sarah H: Adding now. I'll open PR + add CI label. ETA 2h.
Maria P: Perfect. @ken can you coordinate with eng-platform to get the dedicated-regions smoke run? We need one successful run there before cutover.
Ken L: Yep, pinged eng-platform channel and requested a 2-hour slot tonight. cc @eng-platform-bot
devex-bot: Deploy job scheduled: `smoke-samplekit-dedicated` — ETA 2026-03-18T22:15Z — run id: f7a3d9
Ryan G: Small ask: can we keep changelog bullets to 2-3 lines each? Long paragraphs break the release notes layout. I'll format them.
Maria P: Also, owners: final list = Ken (sampleapp smoke), Sarah (quickstart README + samplekit bump), Ryan (changelog bullets). If anyone wants to swap, speak now. Otherwise I'll mark in release tracker.
Alex T: I'll handle the post-release sampleapp template PR if smoke passes. If it fails, I'll triage tomorrow morning.
Maria P: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — if CI green, let's merge by EOD. I'll update the checklist and add the changelog anchor.
Ken L: I'll paste the smoke matrix logs here after the run. If anything looks flaky I'll @ryan and @alex to triage.
Sarah H: PR for README and version bump opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/89 — tagging @maria for review.
Ryan G: Draft changelog bullets uploaded to the tracker doc. Keeping them <3 lines each and adding links to the PRs.
Maria P: Great — closing the loop: merging plan = green CI -> merge samplekit bump -> merge SDK quickstart -> cut the release branch. I'll post a final ✅ when done.
